name: Omeprazole
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.effect: Lower levels of clopidogrel's active metabolite and less platelet inhibition (label).
key_interactions.action: Avoid; consider an alternative antiplatelet therapy (label).

key_interactions.effect: Lower rilpivirine exposure, loss of antiviral effect and resistance (label).
Lower antiretroviral exposure, loss of effect and resistance (label).
Raised INR and prothrombin time; bleeding (label).
key_interactions.action: Monitor INR and adjust warfarin as needed.

key_interactions.effect: Higher citalopram exposure and QT prolongation risk (label).
key_interactions.action: Limit citalopram to 20 mg per day.

key_interactions.effect: Higher exposure to an active cilostazol metabolite (label).
key_interactions.action: Reduce cilostazol to 50 mg twice daily.
Monitor levels or sedation; adjust the dose if needed.

key_interactions.effect: Possible higher tacrolimus exposure, especially in CYP2C19 intermediate or poor metabolizers (label).

key_interactions.action: Use with caution in transplant patients.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Drugs needing gastric acid for absorption (iron salts, ketoconazole, itraconazole, erlotinib, dasatinib, nilotinib)
key_interactions.action: See the other drug's prescribing information.
